args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) failed health checks in production with an 18% error rate. Rolled back to the most recent healthy release, v2.3.0, in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified as rolled_out. Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated** — `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production version.

2. **Rolled back** — Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified as `rolled_out` (all regions now on v2.3.0).

3. **Opened incident** — Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and that root cause investigation is ongoing. The on-call engineer was paged.

Note: v2.3.1 was never healthy in production, so per policy a future redeploy of it would require change-manager approval.
